title: Security Services Directory / Norisuke Network
summary: Historical directory entry for security contractor Saigyou Norisuke.
body:
DIRECTORY ENTRY

SAIGYOU NORISUKE

Listed historically as an independent security contractor and coordinator operating through a network of affiliated personnel.

The directory does not establish the full size or structure of the network. Norisuke's name appears in multiple commercial security records over an extended period.

ARCHIVE NOTE

A withdrawn Brightside profile is held under ARC-326-0417.
